title: A simple stability analysis of the Lanczos algorithm in finite precision arithmetic
summary: We give a self-contained analysis of the symmetric Lanczos algorithm without reorthogonalization when computations are performed inexactly. We show the computed Lanczos vectors are well-behaved locally. From this we (i) prove Paige's loss-of-orthogonality identity, and (ii) construct a Greenbaum-type backward stability result, exhibiting a nearby problem on which exact Lanczos produces the computed tridiagonal matrix.
